title: Guards! Guards!
author: Terry Pratchett
summary: A secret order summons a dragon to Ankh-Morpork in order to install a puppet king, and the city's neglected, underpaid Night Watch is left to deal with it. Led by the weary Captain Vimes and a new recruit, they have to investigate.
readIf: you want a funny, clever fantasy detective story with a loveable ragtag police force.
skipIf: you want a very serious fantasy, as it is full of puns, parody and footnotes.

pairings.reason: Same co-author, a similarly witty and humane comedy about people muddling through a supernatural mess.
Another Discworld novel that is gentler and more about growing up, with Death as a major character.
Another fantasy set in a gritty city with sharp humour, though far more violent and adult.
